principles: Use deterministic/statistical control and forecasting where they outperform or out-efficiency LLMs.
Use LLMs for semantic reasoning, document interpretation, diagnostics, planning and explanation—not for direct actuation.
Primary means first eligible advisory candidate, not monopoly share or authority.
Cross-model agreement is not evidence; measurements and receipts are evidence.

authority_boundary.physical_control_authority: existing PLC/SCADA, hard interlocks, approved deterministic control
authority_boundary.recommendation_path: model -> deterministic constraint validator -> operator approval -> PLC/SCADA
authority_boundary.emergency_behavior: compute/advisory plane may fail without preventing plant operation

network_boundary.AI_data_plane: read-only telemetry replica or approved broker

model_roles.note: Current official references; exact deployment checkpoint/API/local configuration must be pinned in the deployment manifest.

current_reference: Qwen3 open-weight family for local benchmark
Qwen3.8 hosted family as optional current reference
model_roles.note: Local and hosted Qwen lanes are distinct; exact checkpoint selected by measured accuracy, latency, energy and data-residency fit.
Optional, non-critical-path, data-egress gated; no raw OT data by default.

ORCS_vendor_diversity.implication: DeepSeek may be the plurality/default eligible local family while the router prevents single-vendor monoculture. Qwen and an approved independent third lane provide fallback/cross-validation when policy permits.

routing_features: cost only after tariff/model pricing boundaries are known
disagreement_policy: Disagreement escalates; agreement still does not authorize physical action.
benchmark_rule: No family is permanently privileged. Routing priority can change only after benchmark receipts and policy review.
